01 / A little about me

Curious by nature.
Practical by approach.

I'm Nonkumbuzo Mazendala, an Industrial Engineering graduate with experience in warehouse operations, ecommerce seller support and process improvement. Currently working in operations at Takealot, I’m passionate about improving how people, processes and technology work together to deliver efficient, reliable service.

My experience at DSV introduced me to the physical flow of stock and the detail behind reliable dispatch. At Takealot, I bring that process mindset into seller support, while developing my capabilities in SQL and AI assisted workflows.
